query:
SELECT title, slug, status, phase, 
  CASE WHEN content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as hasContent
FROM mcu_media 
WHERE mediaType = 'movie' 
ORDER BY releaseOrder
